portal_hypertension.title: Gut dysbiosis and nitric oxide dysregulation in cirrhosis progression: mechanistic insights and pathophysiological implications.
portal_hypertension.authors: Răzniceanu V, Țichindeleanu A, Răducu EV
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：肠道屏障功能障碍会促进细菌易位，从而使肝脏暴露于脂多糖和病原体相关分子模式中，从而通过 Toll 样受体信号传导引发肝脏炎症，这种现象会因肠道菌群失调而加剧。 临床提示：肠屏障功能障碍促进细菌易位，从而使肝脏暴露于脂多糖和病原体相关分子模式，通过 Toll 样受体触发肝脏炎症
portal_hypertension.abstract: Cirrhosis represents the end stage of chronic liver injury, characterized by progressive fibrosis and architectural distortion that precipitate portal hypertension and systemic complications. Recent evidence positions gut microbiota dysbiosis and nitric oxide (NO) dysregulation as central, interacting pathophysiological mechanisms in cirrhosis progression. Intestinal barrier dysfunction facilitates bacterial translocation and thereby exposes the liver to lipopolysaccharides and pathogen-associated molecular patterns that trigger hepatic inflammation via Toll-like receptor signalling, a phenomenon aggravated by dysbiosis.
